The running session stops, and the runtime MCP changes are lost: added servers disappear, removed ones come back, and connected or disconnected servers return to their configured state.

Stored by the engine in its own database, inside the app\'s private storage. It is not written to any config file.
The new key is stored first and the old one is only removed after it is accepted, so a rejected key cannot leave the provider without one.
